summary: Guardforce AI Co., Limited filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $3,115,495 of ordinary shares through H.C. Wainwright Co. as sales agent. Shares trade on Nasdaq under GFAI; last price was $0.3166 on July 29, 2026. The ATM agreement dates to July 2, 2024; manager compensation is up to 3.0% of gross proceeds. No escrow or trust arrangement. Sales are made at prevailing market prices, subject to a public float cap. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
